en: A black-and-white panoramic photograph of a small town nestled in a terraced, hilly landscape with a forested hill in the background. The foreground and middle ground contain numerous buildings typical of rural European architecture, with sloped tile roofs and several multi-story houses. There is a church with a small bell tower visible near the center. The text at the bottom identifies the location and elevation.
